producer_report.summary: Added `check_behavior_test_design` in athena-core (surveys.rs), wired as one `step!` line right after `check_code_survey`. For a code or tests reading with a behavior criterion it reads labelled clauses of the `Code survey:` assumptions and refuses unless: (a) it has an entry point, a gate order (two or more names) and a stop gate that is one of them; (b) it names a reused function or says 'no existing function'; (c) its `Output:` says no new output, names a record kind from a list pinned to `AnyRecord` and `HistoryRecord`, or names a round-trip test with a deliverable that can hold it; (d) each non-routine behavior criterion has its own `Direct check: criterion N` clause with a measurement word that names an entry point, a gate or a planner, producer or model call. It also refuses contradictions: stop gate outside the order, 'no new output' beside a record deliverable, unknown tags or variants, and measuring through a skip switch or an internal helper. Skip-switch matching has local negation (a negator governs only the item it reaches through articles and prepositions) and exempts only `no_change` and `no_change_reason`. The refusal error names the check, each missing letter and ends with `CODE_SURVEY_EXAMPLE`, a new constant in athena-context. `check_code_survey`'s own error now lists the labels and ends with the same example. The reader guide was rewritten in place within the 3045-byte limit. Tests: unit tests in reading.rs (nested module `design_tests`, including `record_kinds_match_the_enums` and the replay-arithmetic test), 37 corpus cases plus 31 input-form tags in refusal_corpus.rs, and a CLI case in main.rs. Existing whole-gate fixtures now add a complete survey via `with_design`. verify.rs changed in visibility only (`clause_words`, `is_negator` are `pub(crate)`). CHANGELOG has the entry with the matching limits. No prompt file, athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflow or records/ file was touched. The real replay share is not measured by me; my estimate is above the 35% limit (see open_issues).

open_issues: Replay: not measured by me. The in-loop replay (loop_replay) will report the real share and newly refused job ids. By my estimate it is well above the declared 30% plus 5 points = 35%, because no past reading has the new labels. Per the plan I did not loosen labels, markers, phrase lists, exemptions or the declared 30%. A held replay is a Blocker finding and the job would end Rejected, not held for a person. The user's open question about a larger declared share (with a reason) still stands.

Plan departures: the label clauses and Direct check parsing are as planned, but the `Code survey:` joined text accepts a label after any whitespace or a full stop; `RECORD_KINDS` is a 43-entry list pinned by `record_kinds_match_the_enums`; a pub SCHEMA_TAGS in athena-data remains a follow-up. Tests for the whole-gate fixtures in reading.rs use `with_design`, which appends the complete survey (no crates/ path) to readings that carry a `Code survey:`, instead of editing each fixture; `SURVEY` stays short and `check_code_survey` unit tests are unchanged.

The guide was cut to fit: it keeps the labels `Entry point:`, `Gate order:`, `Stop gate:`, `Reuses:`, `Output:`, `Direct check: criterion N`, the name `check_behavior_test_design`, 'not a skip switch', and the routine-criterion sentence ('needs none'), but not `Existing code:`. Pins for 'order in which resolution and probing run', 'allow-list', 'check_record_file' and 'measured directly' were dropped with the text they covered.
mistakes: First `BRIDGE_WORDS` included measured/checked/verified/tested, which made 'is refused, measured through a skip switch' pass as negated; I replaced it with a rule that a participle passes only right after a plain negator (not a refusal verb).

One fixture used 'refuses with --no-probe' as an example refusal, but 'refuses' is a means-negator, so it was accepted; the fixture now says 'stops with --no-probe'. A direct check that uses 'refuses' just before a skip switch is therefore read as negated (a limit of the lexical rule).
learnings: The reader rules section was already near its 3045-byte baseline; a label-list guide fit only after trimming the refusal-rule sentences, so the filled-in example lives in CODE_SURVEY_EXAMPLE, outside the brief.
Whole-gate fixtures in reading.rs go through accept(), gate_refuser(), refuser_for() and refuser(); routing those through `with_design` kept most existing tests unchanged.
A tests-module helper named design_reading already exists for design readings, so the new tests sit in the nested module `design_tests`.
names_record_evidence splits at '.', so an `athena.<kind>/<n>` tag never matches it; the new check reads tags itself.
The evidence snapshot has 234 readings in records/jobs/2026-11, 188 of class code or tests, and none before this job carries a `Gate order:` label.
desires: A way to run the in-loop replay locally over the evidence snapshot's readings, to report the measured share and newly refused job ids instead of an estimate.
